strapiBlog.title: Staycations Takes Center Stage this Summer in the UAE
strapiBlog.short_description: This Eid Al Adha, the UAE witnessed a surprising shift in travel behavior: a large number of UAE residents chose staycation experiences over long-haul travel. Visa's Travel Pulse: Eid Al Adha Edition revealed that 87% of residents favored short getaways instead of extended international vacations.

data.text:
This Eid Al Adha, the UAE witnessed a surprising shift in travel behavior: a large number of UAE residents chose staycation experiences over long-haul travel. Visa's Travel Pulse: Eid Al Adha Edition revealed that 87% of residents favored short getaways instead of extended international vacations. Whether it was a quick city escape or a luxe weekend retreat, this Eid staycation in the UAE 2025 became the preferred choice for many.
Let's decode what are the driving forces behind this shift?

Dubai Dominates the Domestic Scene

Dubai emerged as the clear leader in this year’s staycation scene, capturing a remarkable 70% of all local travel spending. Residents indulged in five-star hotels, curated dining experiences, and premium entertainment options, reaffirming the city’s status as the go-to destination for a luxury staycation in the UAE.

In contrast, Abu Dhabi attracted 21% of staycationers, drawing visitors with upscale leisure and family-friendly activities. Sharjah made its mark with 33% of visitor spending dedicated solely to food and dining, highlighting its appeal as a culinary hub.

The appeal of UAE staycations summer 2025 isn’t just in convenience, it’s showing up in the numbers too. Domestic travel spending surged by 68% compared to the previous year, while average spend per card increased by 20%. These stats point to a significant consumer shift: UAE residents are embracing premium local experiences, not just as a fallback, but as the main event.

Why Are Staycations on the Rise?

Several key factors are driving this rise in staycation trends in the UAE this summer. Travel fatigue from long-haul planning, the desire for more family-oriented options, and the convenience of instant, local luxury have all contributed to this change.

Add to that the growing number of visa-exclusive deals and reward-based partnerships with hotels and merchants, and it’s no wonder why UAE residents choose staycation options over boarding long flights.

The International Picture Still Counts

While domestic travel UAE summer 2025 took the spotlight, international travel wasn’t entirely off the radar. Outbound travel grew by 2%, with London, Paris, and Istanbul ranking as the top destinations. London alone accounted for 4% of outbound travelers and 5% of total international spend. Paris attracted those seeking luxury shopping, while Istanbul appealed to budget-conscious travelers interested in retail and culture.

More Than Just a Trend

UAE staycations summer 2025 became more than just a seasonal shift, they became a lifestyle choice. Residents are increasingly opting for the comfort of high-end local getaways, with Ras Al Khaimah, Abu Dhabi, and Dubai offering tailored experiences that rival any international escape. UAE residents choose staycation not because they have to, but because they genuinely want to.

Short-Term Rentals: A Growing Staycation Option in the UAE

As UAE staycations summer 2025 gain popularity, short-term rentals are emerging as a flexible, premium alternative to traditional hotel stays. Providers like Provident Estate offer a curated portfolio of fully furnished apartments and villas in prime Dubai locations, complete with amenities like Wi-Fi, housekeeping, and 24/7 guest support. 

Ideal for families or couples seeking privacy and home-like comfort, these rentals cater to both holidaymakers and property owners looking to maximize returns. With global platform exposure and tailored property management services, short-term rentals are redefining what a luxury staycation in the UAE can look like.

Top 5 Staycations in Dubai

From beachside resorts to urban retreats, Dubai offers no shortage of luxury staycation options. Here are some of the most sought-after staycation spots in Dubai this summer, offering a mix of luxury, convenience, and unforgettable experiences.

Atlantis The Palm

A top choice for UAE staycations summer 2025, Atlantis The Palm offers up to 25% off, plus an extra 10% through the Atlantis Unlocked membership. Highlights include waterpark access, a dolphin sunrise session, marine encounters, kids activities, and fitness center entry—perfect for a luxury staycation in the UAE.

Burj Al Arab

Perfect for a luxury staycation in the UAE, Jumeirah Summer Escapes offers up to 10% off when staying three nights or more at Burj Al Arab. Perks include a USD 200 resort credit, daily breakfast, half-board dining options, Hermès amenities, butler service, and access to SAL, Talise Spa, Summersalt Beach Club, and a private beach. UAE residents choose staycation packages like this for unmatched comfort and style.

Armani Hotel Dubai

Enjoy a premium UAE staycations summer 2025 experience at the Armani Hotel in Downtown Dubai. Book a room or suite and receive up to 15% off, U by Emaar member discounts, and two complimentary attraction tickets. From Dubai Aquarium to KidZania and Skyview thrills, it's a perfect blend of leisure and location.

One&Only Royal Mirage

Experience an elegant UAE staycations summer 2025 at One&Only Royal Mirage with exclusive summer privileges. Guests can enjoy savings of 15% or more on longer stays, daily waterpark access, evening drinks, spa treatments, and afternoon tea. Families benefit too, with kids staying and dining free at Arabian Court. Please note that you are required to book a minimum stay of 2 nights to avail this offer.

Sofitel Dubai Downtown

Family Escapade by Le Petit Prince is a great option for UAE staycations summer 2025. This offer includes 50% off on connecting rooms, exclusive perks for members, and is perfect for families booking for 2 adults and up to 2 children.
